prompt.alinti: This is one of the most slept on GitHub repos right now. Most of the time you give Claude a link to a website that you like, it comes out barely looking like the reference. But this repo called screenshot to code finally got this right.
Let's find out how well it can clone the Crunchyroll website.
While we wait, I asked Claude Cole to do the same thing so we can compare the results

yontem.alinti: Convert screenshots, mockups, Figma designs and screen recordings into clean, functional code using AI.
